blocking_findings.reason: main constructs one head and one optimizer, then run_cell updates that same pair first for A1X_ACCESS_TRUE and then for A1X_ACCESS_SHUFFLED. The frozen card requires an identical shuffled-target head and optimizer reset for every cell, so the shuffled control must not inherit the two true-cell updates.

main creates D_ref and D_rep examples by calling load_example with the same six roots and name, while load_example never uses operator to select an operator artifact or compute an operator-specific tensor. The two required frozen operators therefore produce duplicated inputs and targets distinguished only by a string label.

active_support returns torch.ones_like for every target and no frozen support asset or support computation is loaded. normalized_active_support_endpoint_mse therefore becomes a full-tensor loss rather than the frozen active-support endpoint loss required by the card and repair authorization.

measure_checks reads final_projection.weight only after both cells have completed two optimizer steps, even though the same run requires nonzero gradients. This does not test the frozen zero-initialized current-endpoint no-op before work and makes the required exact 0.0 gate dependent on post-training weights.

the entrypoint never selects or moves the model, head, or probes to CUDA; profile_measurement requests CPU profiler activity only and does not enable memory profiling. It cannot establish the card's matched convir-4090 CUDA latency and peak-memory overhead gates at both native shapes.

the learned-state manifest records path=not_exported and sha256=null for both cells, and phase_timings contains only one total_seconds value. The frozen lifecycle requires retained per-cell state paths and hashes plus setup/cache/train/eval-or-audit/summary/closeout phase timings sufficient for reconstruction and receipt validation.

after all integrated checks pass, the success path always writes COMPLETED_GATE_INCONCLUSIVE with authorizes NONE. The route card and route_operations.json require S0 PASS to write COMPLETED_GATE_PASS / V4A_A1X_S0_PASS_AUTHORIZE_FORMAL_ONLY / A1X_FORMAL_CONFIRMATION_ONLY, while engineering gate failures use their frozen fail or inconclusive tuples.

semantic_findings checks a small set of AST calls and source substrings and does not test cell reset, operator-specific data flow, real active support, no-op measurement ordering, CUDA cost measurement, retained state hashes, phase timings, or terminal tuple selection. Its EXPECTED first32 tuple also contains 1650_0.78_1.77.png instead of the authoritative 1650_0.76_1.07.png and is never compared with S0_FIRST32_NAMES. The recorded zero findings, nine negatives, aggregate rejection, self-proofs, and proof-marker list therefore do not prove the frozen runner semantics.
